messages:
Irene: Draft RN uploaded: https://docs.internal/rn/infer-2.7-draft. Target deploy 2024-12-10 17:00 UTC. Need quick ops + comms checks.
Omar: On it. Are we pinning to model tag v2.7.0-canary for the canary window?
Irene: Yes. Canary: 6% traffic, duration 10h. Auto-promote to v2.7.0 after checks pass.
Ben: Rollback criteria we should list: sustained 5xx >=3.5% for 10m OR p95 latency increase >1.8x baseline for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Also flag manual rollback if eval set shows regressions.
Irene: Good. Assign rollback owner: Casey for first 12h. Casey: I can take that. If I roll back I'll open #incident-inference and ping infra lead.
Casey: Rollback command to include in RN:
```
infractl rollback --service=inference --to-tag=v2.6.14 --reason "canary_failure"
```
Omar: Add telemetry tag rn=infer-v2.7-canary and post-deploy eval prompt set link. Internal preflight at T-12m, internal announce at T-5m, customer-facing note T+3h if canary OK. Embargo yes.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy 2024-12-10T17:00:00Z. Canary config: 6% traffic for 10h. Fallback target: v2.6.14.
Ben: Microcopy for PMs: "No functional user changes; throughput/latency improvements for long responses (~6-10%)." Recommend adding exact percent range.
Irene: I'll update RN with thresholds, owner, telemetry tag, runbook link, and the rollback command. Casey, please verify the runbook link is correct.
Casey: Confirmed runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rollback-inference. I'll paste a minimal verification checklist after deploy.
Omar: All good from infra side. Go ahead with internal announce schedule. I'll shadow the dashboards at deploy time.
Irene: Thanks team 44d sending final internal preflight at T-12m and will pin this thread in RN folder.
